entry.title: Hello, world! 👋
entry.content:
Backend software engineer with 6+ years of experience across SaaS, observability, and privacy-tech industries.

Skilled in JavaScript, Go, Java, and Python, I design scalable platforms, build internal tools, and solve high-impact production issues in fast-paced environments.

At Datadog, I developed gRPC services in Go, created debugging/monitoring tools that boosted team efficiency by 30%, and integrated LLMs that reduced manual workload by 47%. I’ve also led client escalations, mentoring, and earned the Top Dog Award for exceeding support targets.

Recognized with the Altice Labs Award for Best Master’s Student (2024), I combine strong academic foundations with hands-on problem solving.

Passionate about observability, automation, and AI-driven developer productivity. Open to opportunities where I can bridge engineering and customer impact.

And what the future holds.
entry.summary: A little bit about me and this portfolio.
